name: Catnip

companions.note: Catnip repels flea beetles and aphids — a great brassica protector
Same flea beetle deterrence as with kale
Catnip repels aphids and spider mites; both are heavy feeders that benefit from pest reduction

pnw_notes: Perennial that dies back to roots in winter and returns vigorously each spring — sometimes too vigorously. Deadhead after flowering to prevent aggressive self-seeding. Lavender-white flower spikes are excellent for bees and butterflies. Jazzy will be very interested in this plant while young — consider a small cage or wire cloche while it establishes, as repeated rolling can damage new growth. Safe for cats.

frost_hardiness.notes: Dies back to the ground in winter and regrows reliably from the roots each spring. No protection needed.

planting_windows.notes: Fall transplant viable — roots establish in cool soil; protect young plant from cats while establishing
Direct sow in spring; slow from seed but vigorous once established
Harvest leaves and flowering tips; potency is highest just before peak bloom
